heroSubtitle: Centralize your prospects, organize follow-ups, track your sales team and manage your sales from one platform.
demoSubtitle: 12 stages included by default — adapt them to your sales process
demoDesc1: New Prospect: Automatic import with phone cleaning (E.164 +221) and anti-duplicate check.
demoDesc2: To Contact: Prospect is ready for first contact by the sales representative.
demoDesc3: Contacted: First exchange completed, qualifying interest.
demoDesc4: Interested: Prospect confirmed interest in the Faciloop solution.
demoDesc5: Meeting Set: Meeting date scheduled with automatic notification.
demoDesc6: Demo Done: Product demonstration completed, awaiting feedback.
demoDesc7: Trial Ongoing: Prospect is testing the platform.
demoDesc9: Payment Pending: Invoice sent, awaiting payment.
demoDesc10: Won Client: Deal closed! Converted into an active client.
demoDesc11: To Follow-up Later: Prospect on hold for scheduled later follow-up.
demoDesc12: Lost Prospect: Mandatory loss reason for continuous improvement.
featuresTitle: Designed for your sales reps' efficiency
feature1Desc: Visualize your opportunities with drag-and-drop, loss reason tracking, and client conversion.
feature2Desc: Launch pre-filled WhatsApp conversations in 1 click right from the prospect card.
feature3Desc: Stay in control of today's meetings and never miss a follow-up.
feature4Desc: Each sales rep only sees their own portfolio. Admins get a full team overview.
feature5Desc: Track revenue, conversions, and compare sales team performance with dynamic charts.
feature6Desc: Import prospect lists with duplicate detection and bulk assignment to your team.
